title: How a SCUFFLE Decided the Browns' Most Important Battle of 2026
description:
Spencer Fano earned the Cleveland Browns' starting left tackle job after refusing to back down in a training camp scuffle with Pro Bowl edge rusher Jared Verse. Meanwhile, rookie wide receiver Denzel Boston has dominated every practice and earned first-team reps. We break down how two rookies won their jobs before the first preseason game, what it means for the offense, and why this moment defines Todd Monken's culture-building approach in Year One.

With the preseason opener at Chicago just days away, the Browns still have not named a starting quarterback, but they have found answers at two critical positions. Fano's journey from Utah's Outland Trophy winner to Cleveland's franchise left tackle hope, Boston's emergence as the camp's biggest winner, and the fight that sealed a starting job. Plus, what this means for the post-Myles Garrett rebuild.
